entities.name: Maree
entities.description: Goblin chamberlain of the Izzet League on Ravnica, second-in-command to Ral Zarek and leader of the Izzet mech-mages.

entities.name: Ral Zarek
entities.description: Planeswalker and Izzet guildmaster, Maree's superior.

entities.name: Project Lightning Bug
entities.description: Project during which Maree nearly exposed planeswalkers.

entities.name: War of the Spark
entities.description: War during which Maree was Ral's second-in-command.

entities.name: Niv-Mizzet
entities.description: Living Guildpact whose acting deputy Maree became.

events.summary: Maree came close to exposing the existence of planeswalkers as part of Project Lightning Bug.
events.quote: Maree came close to exposing the existence of planeswalkers as part of Project Lightning Bug

events.summary: After the War, Maree became acting guildmaster of the Izzet and acting Deputy to the Living Guildpact Niv-Mizzet.
events.quote: she became acting guildmaster of the Izzet in Ral's absence

events.summary: Maree unsuccessfully tried to depose Ral but retained her position.
events.quote: She unsuccessfully tried to depose Ral, but retained her position.

relations.quote: a goblin of the Izzet League on Ravnica
